answer: Audits are recorded in mesa, queued in ember, and ledge publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 16 identities per epoch. A farm of 272 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3423 identities would post 1263 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
